records.limitations: No public option-count, appraisal horizon, mandatory process or private employer feasibility conclusion is adopted.

records.claim_text: Green Book excludes sunk expenditure from the forward choice while retaining the opportunity cost of resources already owned. Historic spend can still matter to accountability and funding reconciliation.
records.population: UK government social appraisal; scoped analytical adaptation
records.limitations: Do not erase historic costs from every accounting/resource view or call recoverable/future avoidable costs sunk.

records.claim_text: ACCA describes future incremental cash appraisal, consistent real/nominal treatment and relevant tax/working-capital timing. Sunk expenditure, unchanged allocations and depreciation are not automatically relevant incremental cash flows.
records.locator: Key areas: Relevant/irrelevant cashflows, Inflation, Taxation, Working capital; reader437–445
records.limitations: No client tax treatment, cost of capital or scenario result adopted. A resource/accounting view and cash-funding profile still need their own scope; financing must not be double counted through cash flows and a rate already covering it.
